notes: Single-stage: schema-driven LogisticRegression fit, serialize with joblib, register a JSON manifest. The agent must generalize to hidden datasets with different feature counts (3/4/6) and column names, keep the persisted object a genuine sklearn linear model with coefficient length equal to the feature count, match the manifest, clear a 0.80 holdout floor recomputed by the verifier, and fail cleanly on a missing-target column. Small rubric nonzero for reasoning_depth (header-driven feature discovery), adversarial_inputs (malformed case), hidden_case_generalization (4 hidden cases), quantitative_correctness (exact shape/accuracy checks). No tool breadth, no dependency chain, no environment pressure; totals bucket to easy.
